after.zh: 地板本来就在前面，算进来机器人就永远停着；所以只看可能有障碍的区域。真实的避障还会用相机的高度和角度，从深度算出每一点离地多高。
after.en: The floor is always in front, so counting it would keep the robot stopped for ever; only the region where obstacles can be is checked. Real obstacle avoidance also uses the camera's height and angle to work out how high above the floor each point is.

t.zh: 地板没有纹理，算出来的距离在那几行乱跳。机器人只关心地面以上、离得很近的东西。
t.en: The floor has no texture, so the distances worked out on those rows jump about. The robot only cares about things above the floor that are very close.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：标出地面以上、近到要停下的像素。
t.en: Your task in this level: mark the pixels above the floor that are close enough to stop for.

brief.zh: 距离近于 1.2 米、又在地面以上的像素输出 1，其余 0。
brief.en: Output 1 for pixels closer than 1.2 m that are above the floor, otherwise 0.

hint.zh: 阈值留下的是「大于」的那边。
hint.en: A threshold keeps the "greater than" side.
